content.short: ION Finance is a TON trading app focused on order book markets, liquidity tools, and project launch support.
content.description: ION Finance is a TON trading protocol and app positioned as a more advanced alternative to a basic swap interface. Its public app materials describe central limit order books, liquidity books, and launch support for new TON ecosystem projects. The product is aimed at traders and liquidity providers who want more control over execution, pricing, and capital placement than a standard automated market maker can provide. In the TON market, it sits closer to an active trading venue than a simple retail exchange flow for casual spot users.
content.meta: ION Finance offers order book trading, liquidity tools, and launch support for TON markets and token listings on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
